reviews.title: PNY GeForce 5060 ti 16gb GPU.
reviews.comment: I bought this card back in September. It's still working and it is giving me 229 fps on Ark: Survival Ascended with all graphics presets on epic, and running it on DLSS 4x. It's a beast of a card. I bought it when it was $429.99. But it's worth more than what it's going for now even at a slightly inflated price tag. I paired it with a 5700g cpu, which is an underrated work horse. I only see 65% spikes of utilization when playing a known resource hungry game like Ark: Survival Ascended. I like AMDs current line up of cpus from the zen 2000s to 3000s to the 5000s, which is all I have experience with, and I am impressed by the aging of am4 chips. Which I believe my cpu chip and my gpu will last me until Microsoft comes out with directx13, in which case I will have to upgrade, but I don't think that'll have to happen for many many more yrs. But, yeah I'd say buy this GPU under or equal to $700. It's well worth it.
reviews.author: Jimmy Treadway
